== Summary ==
Between rounds of the 160+ player Enhanced Cloud City tournament, Marcus Certa sings Broadway show tunes. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Marcus Certa]], [[SWCCG Memorabilia]].
